counterexample.note: The bitmap bit checked for start tick 105 is the bit of tick 100, so the repair keeps 105 as the first tick. Tick 105 is not a multiple of the tick spacing and is not initialized. The liquidity total still matches only because tick 105 has no liquidity.

summary: Skips _advanceToNextDown when the bitmap bit at the compressed start position is set, so currentTick stays at startTick. This works for aligned start ticks, but for an unaligned start it returns the start tick itself, which is not initialized.
